classificationVocabulary.decision-bearing: Contains an adopted choice, an explicit alternative, or rationale suitable for atomic decision extraction.
classificationVocabulary.unresolved: Records an open question, proposed choice, or implementation blocked on a decision.
classificationVocabulary.superseded: Preserved historical source whose operative disposition was replaced by a later accepted source.
classificationVocabulary.out-of-scope: Named by the epic as a boundary or negative control but excluded from the gate.
classificationVocabulary.proposal: Open or draft supporting evidence that has not been merged, ratified, or delivered.
classificationVocabulary.mechanical: Implements, mirrors, validates, operationalizes, or coordinates an already-made decision without independently choosing policy.

freshnessNotes: GitHub issue state and bodies are mutable and reflect capturedAt; stable issue and comment URLs identify the evidence but do not make mutable prose immutable.

ownerDecisionSources.decision: Controlled first-party direct cutover; fixture packages migrate, fixture repositories do not gain identity; repair meaningful data rather than delete it.
Nine field-row rendering decisions used as binding input to RFC-037.
Allow-listed fieldType predicates, transitional effective-single union, exact legacy text-search behavior, and deferred composite recursion.
Keep the 33 existing kebab-case Field names verbatim and reject new kebab-case names.
Metamodel package-ID reassignment and uniqueness guard stand as shipped; no normative model change.
The .srs marker is a directory; non-emptiness is a convention rather than a normative rule.
The ext:discovery fixture package reaches the final contract while its enclosing fixture tree remains test data rather than a repository.
A presentation concern degrades silently; a semantic claim fails loudly; neither substitutes.
ownerDecisionSources.note: Explicit negative control: generated proposal, not owner intent and not eligible as a ratified decision.

ownerDecisionSources.summary: Keep list cardinality in Field.fieldType, repair the two mistranslated table fields, reject contradictory deprecated assignment cardinality, and keep requiredness contextual.
Reassign the generated metamodel package while preserving the established hand-authored package identity, regenerate references, and add a repository-wide uniqueness guard.

Resolved semantic records are authoritative; published narrative surrounds typed generated-view slots; generated tables, optional pseudo-IDL, and schema expose structure; unpublished shadows are not authority. This architecture also supports effective inherited extension-owned Relation facets in F206.
ownerDecisionSources.note: The exact #274 comment is a ratified research result. F206 additionally relies on canonical extension ownership; this entry does not claim F206 was implemented by the comment itself.

ownerDecisionSources.summary: Model the live definition-layer surface without a remainder overlay, represent extension facets through inherited Types, accept the inheritance floor, and add a documentation-only per-context description slot that cannot override Field semantics.

Keep the description change in #273, initially model the then-live deprecated carrier surface, and require byte-level artifact comparison rather than property-key parity. The later #242-first ordering superseded the deprecated-carrier portion only.

Move #242 before #273, exclude the carrier surface #242 deletes, preserve inherited live facets, narrow the contextual annotation to description, and defer generic deprecation capability until demanded.

Confirm post-#242 live-surface modelling and full byte-level regeneration, while explicitly retaining Field.deprecatedAt and its projection as an unresolved #234 decision rather than inferring its removal.
ownerDecisionSources.note: This is a recorded owner scope reconciliation, not evidence that the unresolved deprecatedAt policy has been decided.

ownerDecisionSources.summary: Keep defaultValue policy open and route its definition-layer decision into #273/#272; allowlisting or current schema presence does not close the issue.

Rust consistently rejects unknown Field-shape properties across nested and carrier paths while modelling $schema explicitly; this resolves implementation inconsistency, not the remaining normative extension policy.
Rust rejection resolves only an implementation contradiction; #273 still must decide normative reject/preserve behavior, sanctioned extensions, and any escape-bag shape.
Before instance-layer authoring, inventory every schema and bind it to source Types, extension dependencies, emitter, and generated status or explicit exclusion.

Keep #271 last; require pure regenerate-and-diff, synchronized mirrors, byte equality, and no remainder overlay, while retaining a hardened residual checker wherever generated prose does not yet replace RFC-031.
ownerDecisionSources.note: The sequence and acceptance shape are recorded; #271 remains open, so this is not delivered evidence.

ownerDecisionSources.summary: Regenerate-and-diff covers records-to-schema but not prose-to-schema by itself; RFC-031 cannot be retired until #274 determines generated coverage and a fail-closed residual role.
PR #778 did not generate the full Rust binding/validator layer; epic closure must either add and gate that seam or explicitly narrow the epic and sequence it as a named follow-on.
